{{Quote|What of the reports of the Rebel fleet massing near Sullust?|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="Episode 6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
The '''Sullust system''' was located in the [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], homeworld of the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]], and centered around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Sullust (star)|Sullust]].

==History==
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] [[Battle of Sullust (4 ABY)|gathered]] in the Sullust system in order to [[Battle of Endor/Legends|attack]] the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="RoJ">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref><ref name="TEA" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places the Sullust system in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The Sluis sector is actually located in the Outer Rim.

Additionally, ''Rebellion's'' in-game encyclopedia entry for Sullust claims that the Sullust system threw its support to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. In actuality, only the [[Sullustan Resistance|Sullustan resistance movement]], which remained independent of the Alliance, provided some support and aid, while Sullust itself remained deeply divided.
